correctness.rationale: The transfer-current kernel was solved explicitly and diagonalized; the PGF factorization follows algebraically from exact joint inclusion probabilities. Edge cases were checked, 394 prescribed-submatching counts were independently reproduced by Matrix-Tree contraction through order 8, and 89 full matching-intersection distributions were directly enumerated through order 6.

originality.rationale: General fixed-forest enumeration and the bipartite specialization are credited as prior work. Targeted published-finding corpus and current-literature searches found no equivalent complete-multipartite matching-intersection Poisson-binomial law; the novelty claim is restricted to that rank-one transfer-current specialization and its distributional consequences.

value.rationale: The theorem provides the full law of the number of selected matching edges, all joint inclusion probabilities, exact prescribed-submatching counts, and pairwise covariance in closed form for every complete multipartite graph and every matching confined to two parts.
